messages:
maria: Creating RC for inference-api -> rc-2026-03-20a. Includes model pin to model:v1.9-quantized and fast-kernel 2.1. Change window tonight 22:00-23:30 PT. Need sign-offs for canary->prod promotion.

alex: LGTM infra-side. CI smoke green. Commit abc1234. Tags pushed: rc-2026-03-20a.

sasha: QA: ran quick regression tests against the smoke prompt set. One minor reranker mismatch — logged bug #4521. Not blocking canary but would prefer a non-blocking note in release notes.

raj: SRE: plan is 10% canary with 3-minute ramp then observe 15m. Rollback rule: 5xx > 0.5% or error surge for 5m -> rollback. I’ll be on-call to watch.

emily: @maria please add a release note item about embedding dimension change so PMs know.

maria: Added release notes: - Pin model to v1.9-quantized; - KV cache and batching improvements; - fast-kernel pinned to 2.1. Also added the note about embedding dim. Canary config applied.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy rc-2026-03-20a -> staging -> prod-canary. run id: dpl-1785023456. Status: started.

alex: Canary rollout started. Observability tracing flag is OFF for now; will flip on after initial stability.

sasha: Canary smoke check: generation samples look good. Minor tokenization diffs but within tolerance. :thumbsup:

raj: Observed transient p95 spike to 420ms for ~90s during first minute of canary, returned to baseline. No 5xx. Monitoring continues.

maria: If no new regressions we aim to promote to prod at 22:20 PT. Request final +1s from infra/QA/product.

alex: +1 infra.

sasha: +1 QA (non-blocking bug filed #4521).

emily: +1 product.

maria: Proceeding to promote. deploy-bot, start prod rollout with 20% increments every 10m and auto-rollback on the thresholds discussed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion started: rc-2026-03-20a -> prod. Rollout plan: [20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%] interval 10m. Monitors: latency, 5xx, error-rate. run id: dpl-1785023456.

raj: Watching dashboards. If 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m on any slice, trigger rollback. Rollback command (if needed): `./rollback.sh --run dpl-1785023456`.

alex: Pinned model on dedicated pool: model:v1.9-quantized@sha:deadbeef.

sasha: 20% checkpoint OK. Sample sanity checks passed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: 40% -> success.

maria: Noting a small uptick in token cost due to quantized decoding path, still within our cost target. Continue.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: 60% -> success.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: 80% -> success.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: 100% -> success.

maria: Prod promotion complete for rc-2026-03-20a. Changelog and release notes published: https://redwood.internal/releases/rc-2026-03-20a. Thanks all :tada:.

raj: I’ll keep the rollback playbook and incident channel open for two hours, then archive if stable.

alex: Worth a follow-up perf ticket to investigate the initial p95 transient spike. I’ll file one.

sasha: QA will validate the non-blocking bug fix in next sprint.

maria: Closing the loop — marking RC promoted and closing the ticket for release coordination. Great job.
